title: The sync gate's held-out reword check does not run on a landing that changes only articles, though an article edit can match a held-out row to an existing expansion
goal: kg_sync.heldout_checks selects a root's lookup_heldout.csv when a landing changes an article of that root, not only its doc2query expansions.csv, so an article edit whose fact key matches an existing expansion row that rewords a held-out question is refused at the gate (SP-7nv2ffr2 review).
